verses.1: And I saw a new sky and a new earth. For the first time, the sky and the earth were created. And the sea no longer exists anymore.
verses.2: And we saw the holy city of Jerusalem rising from heaven, prepared by God as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.3: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying: “Behold, the temple of God is now among people. It will be set up along with them. And their own people will be there with them. And God himself will be with them.”
verses.4: And all tears from their eyes will be wiped away. Death will no longer exist; neither sorrow, nor crying, nor pain will be there anymore. First, they will be freed from these troubles.
verses.5: And the one sitting on the throne said, “I will do everything differently now.” He also said, “Write down that these words are true and genuine.”
verses.6: And he said to me, “It has happened.” I am the beginning and the end. I will give to those who are thirsty from the source of water that brings life.
verses.7: He who wins will inherit these things. I will be his god, and he will be my son.
verses.8: But for those who are poor, destitute, sick, murderers, prostitutes, drug addicts, and those who worship idols, their share in the lake of fire is death. That is the second death.
verses.9: And one of the seven messengers came, carrying the seven messages, those filled with the seven wounds of the bottom part. He spoke to me, saying, “Lord, I will show you the virgin, the wife of the ram.”
verses.10: And I was carried by a spirit onto a very high and majestic mountain. There, I saw the holy city of Jerusalem, which had been sent down from heaven by God.
verses.11: They had the glory of God. Her lamp was like a precious stone, as beautiful as a stone that has been polished with crystal.
verses.12: It has a large and tall wall. It has twelve gates. On each gate, there are twelve angels. And on those gates, there are names written down, which represent the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.13: Three gates from the east, three gates from the north, three gates from the south, and three gates from the west.
verses.14: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations. On each of those foundations, there were twelve names of the twelve apostles of St. John.
verses.15: And while he spoke with me, he had a golden measuring rod, so that he could measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
verses.16: And the city has a square shape; its area is equal to its width. I measured the city using a rod, and it was twelve thousand stadia in length. Its area, width, and height are all equal.
verses.17: And she measured the thickness of her wall to be sixty-four feet; this is a measure of a human being. This is what the angel’s size is.
verses.18: And the surface of its walls is smooth and polished; the city itself is made of pure gold, just like pure glass.
verses.19: The foundations of the city’s walls are all adorned with precious stones. The first foundation stone is made of jasper; the second one is made of lapis lazuli; the third one is made of copper; and the fourth one is made of smaragd.
verses.20: The fifth is the sardonyx; the sixth is the sardine; the seventh is the golden stone; the eighth is the beryl; the ninth is the topaz; the tenth is the gold; the eleventh is the amethyst; the twelfth is the unpolished diamond.
verses.21: And there were twelve gates, with twelve guards at each gate. And the surface of the city was covered with pure gold, as bright as sunlight.
verses.22: And we did not see any bull in her, for the Lord, God, the Almighty, is her Bull.
verses.23: And the city has no need of the sun or moon, so that they may be seen there. For it was the glory of God that gave it its significance, and its “treasure” is the ram.
verses.24: And nations will wander in her light. And the kings of the earth will bring their glory to her.
verses.25: And her gates never close during the day; for at night, there is no darkness there at all.
verses.26: And they will also receive the glory and honor of the nations in return.
verses.27: And do not allow anything common to be introduced into it, nor do any kind of deceit or falsehood. This is unless what is written in the book of the life of the ram is followed.
